about:
American Steel Works is an owner-operated welding and fabrication shop based in West Warwick, Rhode Island. Founded in 2018 by Giovanni Colasante, the company began with a focus on building customer relationships and delivering custom metalwork from a modest facility on Legris Avenue. Colasante brought over eight years of field experience to the venture.

The shop provides welding across virtually any weldable material and process, custom fabrication to engineered drawings, and a mobile welding rig for on-site work. It handles projects ranging from one-off custom parts to repeat production runs, though specific capacity figures such as facility size, headcount, or annual volume are not published.

Customers include aerospace manufacturers needing critical components and artists seeking decorative metal pieces such as wall art. The company also serves general industrial clients requiring fabrication and repair services, with no minimum order quantity advertised.

American Steel Works emphasizes competitive pricing, attention to detail, and a service philosophy that treats customers like family. The founder’s background of over eight years in the field underpins the commitment to quality and responsiveness, and free quotes are offered for all inquiries.
